text: This report review and recommends approval of the application to amend the Zoning By-law to permit two new buildings on the site at 333-351 King Street East and 200 Front Street East. The proposed development includes a 37-storey residential building (140 metres tall, including mechanical penthouse) on the west side of the site and a 28-storey office building (127 metres tall, including mechanical penthouse) in the centre of the site. The lower level of the new office building would replace some of the existing retail uses fronting on Front Street East. The existing Globe and Mail Centre, Coca-Cola/George Brown building and existing buildings fronting on King Street East would remain in place. The proposal also includes two privately owned publicly-accessible spaces fronting onto Front Street East, and a child care facility with outdoor space on the second floor of the proposed office…
